# Security Policy

## Reporting

- Do not open a public issue
- Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting on this repository
(Security -> Report a vulnerability)
    - Or [email us](mailto:contact@cleanroommc.com?subject=Reporting%20a%20Vulnerability)
    - Alternatively, open a direct message to any of the maintainers on [Cleanroom's Discord](https://discord.cleanroommc.com).

- Please include the affected version, impact, and a way to reproduce it.
